title.en: Fidelity coders on their own and the other's texts
title.zh: 忠实之测之编码者：于己文与他文

statement.en: On 240 English statements written and blind-coded by Claude and GPT, neither coder under-detects referents planted in its own text (interaction +0.02, CI [-0.05, +0.08]); GPT lists more excess in faithful texts (+0.16, CI [+0.08, +0.24]); LLM-coded, provisional.
statement.zh: Claude 与 GPT 各写各盲编 240 句英文陈述：二编码者于己文之植入皆不少检（交互 +0.02）；GPT 于忠实之句列多余所指更多（+0.16）；大模型编码，暂定。

hypotheses.en: FC1's codebook v1.1, table pass with no key; FC1's Lean table (sha256 478c555f…) with one level of unfolding; plants made knowingly by each author in its own words as the ground truth for detection; a plant detected where an excess referent's span carries its new words.
hypotheses.zh: FC1 编码本 v1.1，名表一遍而无键；FC1 之 Lean 表（sha256 478c555f…），展开一层；各作者以己语有意植入者为检出之真值；多余所指之文段含植入之新词则为检出。

does_not_show.en: That the authoring model has no blind spot for its own controlled classical code: the texts are English under no name table, and the 經 case is untested.
does_not_show.zh: 作者模型于其受控之古典之码无盲点：所测为无名表之英文，经之情形未测。

does_not_show.en: That the GPT coder over-reads rather than the Claude coder under-detecting unplanted excess: the faithful texts carry no ground truth; about half of GPT's unplanted count is numerals the codebook matches, described after the fact.
does_not_show.zh: 是 GPT 编码者过读而非 Claude 编码者漏检未植入之多余：忠实之句无真值；GPT 未植入之计数约半为编码本所配之数词，系事后描述。

does_not_show.en: Each coder's self effect apart: two families identify only their sum, and a knowing plant is not an unnoticed slip.
does_not_show.zh: 各编码者之自效应各自几何：二家只能识其和；有意之植入亦非不觉之滑入。

validation_scope.en: Design, decision rule and analysis code committed before any text was written; 480 of 480 codings (Claude: 6 Opus subagents; GPT: 12 gpt-6-astra runs through cx, blind, inline packets); cluster bootstrap over laws, B = 10,000; no human audit.
validation_scope.zh: 设计、判定规则与分析代码于写任何文本之前提交；480 份编码俱全（Claude：6 个 Opus 子代理；GPT：经 cx 之 12 次 gpt-6-astra 运行，盲，内联包）；按定律之聚类自助，B = 10,000；无人工复核。

next_delta.en: The same crossing on the 經 under the name table; adjudication or a human audit of unplanted excess; a third model family to separate the two self effects.
next_delta.zh: 在名表下之经上作同样之交叉；未植入之多余之裁定或人工复核；第三家模型以分二自效应。

correspondence.en: Board item SC1, testing the open observation recorded in FC1's results. Reading (the AI's): the calibration discrepancy is better accounted for by a difference of coding threshold than by a blind spot; the tie to Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough is not supported as an author effect.
correspondence.zh: 看板项 SC1，检验 FC1 结果中所记之开放观察。读法（AI 的）：校准之差以编码阈值之别解释优于以盲点解释；与 Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough 之联系作为作者效应不获支持。

detail.en: Tests the calibration observation recorded with the fidelity count.
detail.zh: 检验忠实之测所记之校准观察。

progress.en: The crossed test run on English statements.
progress.zh: 交叉之测在英文陈述上运行。
